title: cs daily scratchpad - QBRs and renewals
body:
Daily scratchpad - quick wins and reminders

Date: 2026-03-04
Owner: Ethan Morales (CS)

Top priorities for today:
1) BrightHealth QBR prep (10:00 AM PT) - HIGH
   - Pull monthly usage metrics (tokens, embedding calls, peak QPS) -> see Confluence page CONFLUENCE-1234 for metrics dashboard.
   - Talking points: successful latency improvements after optimizing batching last month, 12% cost savings from prefix caching, outstanding items: model hallucination in clinical-summaries route (tickets JIRA-CC-987, JIRA-BH-102).
   - Ask: confirm interest in Dedicated offering and timeline for security review.
   - Prep slide: adoption by product teams + cost delta (hosted vs. dedicated). Maya to send latest cost spreadsheet by 8:30 AM.

2) Acme Retail renewal reminder - due 2026-04-15
   - Contract: $120k ARR, auto-renew discussion next week.
   - Action: Send renewal playbook and proposed discount tiers. Draft email outline below.
   - Check: usage trend last 3 months (spike in November Black Friday prep). Attach usage chart. Jordan to confirm any open support tickets impacting renewal (slack #acme-support thread).

3) NimbleAI support follow-ups
   - JIRA: CC-1013 (model drift alert false positives) - asked ML eng to investigate; assigned to Priya. Status: in-progress.
   - Customer asked for short-term mitigation: increase alert threshold & add daily digest instead of real-time alerts. Send change plan by EOD.

4) Quick triage - outstanding incidents
   - INCIDENT-2026-02-27: latency spike for embeddings route (resolved). Note: send RCA summary to customer-facing mailbox by Friday.
   - INCIDENT-2026-03-01: memory OOM on dedicated pool for internal test customer - follow-up w/infra (ticket INFRA-564).

5) Admin / To-dos
   - Fill QBR template slide deck (slide 3: engagement summary; slide 4: cost/latency trends).
   - Update account tracker spreadsheet with renewal dates and health scores (link: CONFLUENCE-1234).
   - Log time for BrightHealth prep (blocks: 9-10am).
   - Remind Maya about churn-risk playbook updates.

6) Conversation snippets / suggested language (for calls/emails)
   - For cost conversation: "We measured a ~12% token-level cost reduction after enabling prefix caching on your busiest routes; dedicated capacity can further stabilize tail latency and reduce unit cost for sustained traffic patterns."
   - For renewal nudges: "As we approach your renewal window, I wanted to share a few programmatic options we\u2019ve used with similar customers that preserve throughput while lowering overall spend. Happy to walk through scenarios in a quick call."

7) Notes to self / miscellaneous
   - Check with SRE on planned infra maintenance next month - avoids scheduling QBRs during maintenance window.
   - Add BrightHealth to monthly exec summary if they confirm Dedicated interest.
   - Save draft of renewal email to templates folder (will iterate after Jordan confirms support items).

Linked resources / quick links:
- Confluence: CONFLUENCE-1234 (BrightHealth metrics & QBR deck template)
- Jira: JIRA-CC-987, JIRA-BH-102, JIRA-CC-1013
- Slack: #cs-accts, #acme-support

End of scratchpad.
